description: Recent SEC Form D private-placement filings parsed into scored leads (0-100 with reasons): issuer, website and domain when EDGAR has one, industry, related persons and roles, offering amount, amount sold, amount remaining, investor count, use of proceeds, placement agent / broker-dealer with CRD, fund vs operating company, and the sec.gov filing link. Missing values are null. Up to 25 leads per call. Optional date-range backfill of up to 31 days. Costs $0.015 USDC.

endDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, default today when startDate is set.

excludeFunds.description: true to drop pooled investment funds.

industries.description: Comma-separated words matched against the Form D industry group, the filer's clarification, fund type, and SIC description. Example: Technology, biotechnology.

minAmount.description: Minimum raise in USD (amount sold, else offering size).

placementAgentOnly.description: true to keep only raises with a placement agent.

startDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD. With endDate, backfills that filing-date window via EDGAR full-text search (max 31 days). Omit both for the newest filings.

states.description: Comma-separated issuer state codes, e.g. NY,CA. Case-insensitive.

name: formd_leads
